label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (error-message-exposure) is TP. User input retrieved via request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows into the log sink via the 'redacted' variable. Although the regex replaces 'password' or 'token' substrings, the remaining portions of the user-supplied string are logged verbatim. This allows attackers to infer sensitive information based on the length and surrounding context of the input, constituting a sensitive data exposure vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input extracted and logged with incomplete redaction allowing data leakage.
